ActiveAuthIn.description:
The chip's signed answer to the challenge the session issued (`aa_challenge`), as base64 of the plain r||s signature. DG15 must be among the
data groups sent.
ActiveAuthIn.title: ActiveAuthIn

ChipIn.description: What the phone app read from the chip: the signed object (EF.SOD) and the data groups, each as base64. Only group 1 (the MRZ) is read.
ChipIn.title: ChipIn

FaceIn.description:
A live face image and a liveness capture, each base64. Used only when the deployment has an accepted engine and the chip photo came from a data
group the signed object covered; never kept.
FaceIn.title: FaceIn

SelfRunChipIn.description: What the phone app read from the chip: the signed object (EF.SOD) and the data groups, each as base64.
SelfRunChipIn.title: SelfRunChipIn

post.description:
Start the same verification for up to 50 people in one request (plan feature advanced.bulk-identity-company-verification).
Each person is started on its own, exactly as POST /verifications would: one person's failure never stops or hides another's, and each
result says started or why not. A person's short-lived handoff link is returned once, here, and never stored.
